facts.statement: A Ninja Brawl event was held on server 1 where players gathered to duel one another; players had to arrive on time, send duel invitations to other players and accept invitations received.
facts.quote: Envoi des invitations de duel aux autres joueurs et accepte toutes les invitations reçues.

facts.statement: The Americas and Latin America session was on Thursday 17 February 2011 at 3h Pacific time, on server 1.
The UK and Europe session was listed for Friday 18 February 2011 at 18h CET (Paris time) and also as 4:00 GMT, on server 1; the two stated times do not agree with each other.
facts.quote: Vendredi 18 février 2011 18h CET (Heure de Paris) / 4h:00 GMT

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (Événement: Bagarre de Ninja!)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language Free Realms news post announcing a Ninja Brawl (Bagarre de Ninja) player event on server 1, with duel-based fighting and an invitation to become a Ninja by speaking to Ty at the Lakeside. The post gives two scheduled dates, one for the Americas and one for UK/Europe, and the page lacks a clear publish date (it shows only 'posted 3 months, 2 weeks ago').
